title: Chaotic adcomms threaten to derail FDA’s bid to renew trust after Makary, Prasad
snippet: The FDA has been trying to mend fences with rare disease drug developers and patient groups since the departure of former Commissioner Marty Makary three months ago. But advisory committee meetings last week for Replimune and Capricor Therapeutics only created more confusion and frustration.

title: Clinical-radiomic model development for local recurrence prediction in stereotactic body radiation therapy-treated lung cancer: comparative analysis with radiobiological models.
snippet: Accurate prediction of local recurrence (LR) after stereotactic body radiation therapy (SBRT) for lung cancer remains challenging, and conventional radiobiological models have shown limited predictive performance.
